verses.original: וַיֹּ֙סֶף֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה לַחֲר֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֨סֶת אֶת־ דָּוִ֤ד בָּהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ מְנֵ֥ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ’ap̄- Yah·weh la·ḥă·rō·wṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·seṯ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ bā·hem lê·mōr lêḵ mə·nêh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He stirred up - David against them saying Go [and] take a census - of Israel - and Judah

verses.original: הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ יוֹאָ֣ב׀ שַׂר־ הַחַ֣יִל אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֗וֹ שֽׁוּט־ נָ֞א בְּכָל־ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וּפִקְד֖וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וְיָ֣דַעְתִּ֔י אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ’el- yō·w·’āḇ śar- ha·ḥa·yil ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw šūṭ- nā bə·ḵāl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ū·p̄iq·ḏū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·yā·ḏa‘·tî ’êṯ mis·par hā·‘ām
verses.literal: So the king said to Joab the commander of his army who [was] with him Go now throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to vvv Beersheba and register - the troops so that I may know - their number . . .

verses.original: יוֹאָ֜ב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֶל־ וְיוֹסֵ֣ף הָעָ֜ם מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים כָּהֵ֤ם׀ וְכָהֵם֙ וְעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ רֹא֑וֹת לָ֥מָּה וַאדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ חָפֵ֖ץ הַזֶּֽה׃ בַּדָּבָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer ’el- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’el- wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hā·‘ām mê·’āh p̄ə·‘ā·mîm kā·hêm wə·ḵā·hêm wə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ rō·’ō·wṯ lām·māh wa·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ḥā·p̄êṣ haz·zeh bad·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: But Joab replied to the king May the LORD your God . . . multiply the troops a hundred times over . . . and may the eyes of my lord the king see [it] But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing

verses.original: הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ דְּבַר־ וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב וְעַ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל יוֹאָ֜ב וְשָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֙יִל֙ וַיֵּצֵ֨א לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְקֹ֥ד אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ də·ḇar- way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq ’el- yō·w·’āḇ wə·‘al śā·rê he·ḥā·yil yō·w·’āḇ wə·śā·rê ha·ḥa·yil way·yê·ṣê lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ lip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Nevertheless , the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the army So Joab and the commanders of the army departed from the presence of the king to register - the troops - of Israel

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בַעֲרוֹעֵ֗ר יְמִ֥ין הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֥חַל הַגָּ֖ד וְאֶל־ יַעְזֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇa·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr yə·mîn hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal hag·gāḏ wə·’el- ya‘·zêr
verses.literal: They crossed - the Jordan and camped near Aroer south of the town - in the middle of the valley and proceeded toward Gad . . . and Jazer

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔דָה וְאֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֖ים חָדְשִׁ֑י וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ דָּ֣נָה יַּ֔עַן וְסָבִ֖יב אֶל־ צִידֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hag·gil·‘ā·ḏāh wə·’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tîm ḥā·ḏə·šî way·yā·ḇō·’ū dā·nāh ya·‘an wə·sā·ḇîḇ ’el- ṣî·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: Then they went to Gilead and the land vvv of Tahtim-hodshi and vvv on to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִבְצַר־ צֹ֔ר וְכָל־ עָרֵ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י וַיֵּֽצְא֛וּ אֶל־ נֶ֥גֶב יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū miḇ·ṣar- ṣōr wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’el- ne·ḡeḇ yə·hū·ḏāh bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: They went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the cities of the Hivites and Canaanites Finally, they went on to the Negev of Judah vvv [to] Beersheba

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֨ה תִשְׁעָ֧ה חֳדָשִׁ֛ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים י֖וֹם וַיָּשֻׁ֖טוּ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miq·ṣêh ṯiš·‘āh ḥo·ḏā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm yō·wm way·yā·šu·ṭū bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·ḇō·’ū yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: At the end of nine months and twenty days having gone through the whole land they returned to Jerusalem

verses.original: יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וַתְּהִ֣י שְׁמֹנֶה֩ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף אִֽישׁ־ חַ֙יִל֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- way·yit·tên ham·me·leḵ mis·par mip̄·qaḏ- hā·‘ām ’el- yiś·rā·’êl wat·tə·hî šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ’îš- ḥa·yil šō·lêp̄ ḥe·reḇ wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ḥă·mêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: And Joab - reported to the king the total number of the troops . . . In Israel there were 800,000 {} . . . . . . men of valor who drew the sword and in Judah there were 500,000 . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן סָפַ֣ר אֶת־ הָעָ֑םס דָּוִד֙ אֹת֔וֹ לֵב־ וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה חָטָ֤אתִי מְאֹד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה נָא֙ אֶת־ הַֽעֲבֶר־ עֲוֺ֣ן עַבְדְּךָ֔ כִּ֥י מְאֹֽד׃ נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên sā·p̄ar ’eṯ- hå̄·ʿå̄·ms dā·wiḏ ’ō·ṯōw lêḇ- way·yaḵ dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·ṯî mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh nā ’eṯ- ha·‘ă·ḇer- ‘ă·wōn ‘aḇ·də·ḵā kî mə·’ōḏ nis·kal·tî
verses.literal: After . . . [David] had numbered - the troops [his] - conscience was stricken and he said to the LORD I have sinned greatly in what I have done Now O LORD I beg You - to take away the iniquity of Your servant for I have acted very foolishly

verses.original: דָּוִ֖ד וַיָּ֥קָם בַּבֹּ֑קֶר פ וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־ גָּ֣ד הַנָּבִ֔יא דָוִ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃ חֹזֵ֥ה
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yā·qām bab·bō·qɛr p̄ ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’el- gāḏ han·nā·ḇî ḏā·wiḏ lê·mōr ḥō·zêh
verses.literal: When David got up in the morning the word of the LORD had come to Gad the prophet David’s . . . seer

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר אָנֹכִ֖י נוֹטֵ֣ל עָלֶ֑יךָ שָׁלֹ֕שׁ בְּחַר־ לְךָ֥ אַֽחַת־ מֵהֶ֖ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’el- dā·wiḏ kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·w·ṭêl ‘ā·le·ḵā šā·lōš bə·ḥar- lə·ḵā ’a·ḥaṯ- mê·hem wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says I am offering . . . you three [options] Choose one of them and I will carry it out against you

verses.original: גָ֥ד וַיָּבֹא־ וַיַּגֶּד־ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד ל֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֡וֹ הֲתָב֣וֹא לְךָ֣ שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֣ים׀ רָעָ֣ב׀ בְּאַרְצֶ֡ךָ אִם־ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳ֠דָשִׁים נֻסְךָ֨ וְה֣וּא רֹדְפֶ֗ךָ לִפְנֵֽי־ צָרֶ֜יךָ וְאִם־ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֥ים הֱ֠יוֹת דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּאַרְצֶ֔ךָ עַתָּה֙ דַּ֣ע וּרְאֵ֔ה מָה־ דָּבָֽר׃ס אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖י
verses.transliteration: ḡāḏ way·yā·ḇō- way·yag·geḏ- ’el- dā·wiḏ lōw way·yō·mer lōw hă·ṯā·ḇō·w lə·ḵā še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm rā·‘āḇ bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā ’im- šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm nus·ḵā wə·hū rō·ḏə·p̄e·ḵā lip̄·nê- ṣā·re·ḵā wə·’im- šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm hĕ·yō·wṯ de·ḇer bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā ‘at·tāh da‘ ū·rə·’êh māh- dā·ḇār ’ā·šîḇ šō·lə·ḥî
verses.literal: So Gad went and said to David - - - Do you choose to endure . . . three years of famine in your land - three months of fleeing vvv the pursuit of your enemies or three days of plague upon your land Now then think it over and decide how I should reply . . . to Him who sent me

verses.original: דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר גָּ֖ד לִ֣י מְאֹ֑ד צַר־ נָּ֤א נִפְּלָה־ בְיַד־ יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ רַחֲמוֹ רַבִּ֣ים אַל־ אֶפֹּֽלָה׃ וּבְיַד־ אָדָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ ’el- way·yō·mer gāḏ lî mə·’ōḏ ṣar- nā nip·pə·lāh- ḇə·yaḏ- Yah·weh kî- ra·ḥă·mō rab·bîm ’al- ’ep·pō·lāh ū·ḇə·yaḏ- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: David . . . answered Gad I am deeply distressed Please let us fall into the hand of the LORD for His mercies [are] great but do not let me fall into the hands of men

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵהַבֹּ֖קֶר וְעַד־ מוֹעֵ֑ד עֵ֣ת שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף הָעָ֗ם מִן־ מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע אִֽישׁ׃ וַיָּ֣מָת
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yit·tên de·ḇer bə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·hab·bō·qer wə·‘aḏ- mō·w·‘êḏ ‘êṯ šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ hā·‘ām min- mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ’îš way·yā·māṯ
verses.literal: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel from that morning until the appointed time and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to vvv Beersheba - died

verses.original: הַמַּלְאָ֥ךְ׀ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יָד֨וֹ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ֒ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם֮ יְהוָה֙ וַיִּנָּ֤חֶם אֶל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַ֠יֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַמַּשְׁחִ֤ית בָּעָם֙ רַ֔ב הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑ךָ עַתָּ֖ה וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֔ה עִם־ גֹּ֖רֶן הָאוֹרְנָה הַיְבֻסִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ham·mal·’āḵ way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw lə·ša·ḥă·ṯāh yə·rū·šā·lim Yah·weh way·yin·nā·ḥem ’el- hā·rā·‘āh way·yō·mer lam·mal·’āḵ ham·maš·ḥîṯ bā·‘ām raḇ he·rep̄ yā·ḏe·ḵā ‘at·tāh ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh hā·yāh ‘im- gō·ren hå̄·ʾō·rə·nå̄h hay·ḇu·sî
verses.literal: But when the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem the LORD relented from the calamity and said to the angel who was destroying the people Enough Withdraw your hand now At that time the angel of the LORD was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite

verses.original: דָּוִ֨ד בִּרְאֹת֣וֹ׀ אֶֽת־ הַמַּלְאָ֣ךְ׀ הַמַּכֶּ֣ה בָעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶל־ יְהוָ֜ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֙אתִי֙ וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֶעֱוֵ֔יתִי וְאֵ֥לֶּה הַצֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ נָ֥א יָדְךָ֛ תְּהִ֨י בִּ֖י אָבִֽי׃פ וּבְבֵ֥ית
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ bir·’ō·ṯōw ’eṯ- ham·mal·’āḵ ham·mak·keh ḇā·‘ām way·yō·mer way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥā·ṭā·ṯî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî he·‘ĕ·wê·ṯî wə·’êl·leh haṣ·ṣōn meh ‘ā·śū nā yā·ḏə·ḵā tə·hî bî ’ā·ḇî ū·ḇə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: When David saw - the angel striking down the people . . . he said to the LORD Surely I, [the shepherd] have sinned and acted wickedly But these sheep what have they done Please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house

verses.original: הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם גָ֥ד וַיָּבֹא־ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ עֲלֵה֙ הָקֵ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרָנְיָה הַיְבֻסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ḡāḏ way·yā·ḇō- ’el- dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer lōw ‘ă·lêh hā·qêm miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh bə·ḡō·ren ʾå̄·rå̄·nə·yå̄h hay·ḇu·sî
verses.literal: And that day Gad came to David and said to him Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite

verses.original: דָּוִד֙ וַיַּ֤עַל כִּדְבַר־ גָּ֔ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘al kiḏ·ḇar- gāḏ ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: So David went up at the word of Gad just as the LORD had commanded

verses.original: אֲרַ֗וְנָה וַיַּשְׁקֵ֣ף וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו עֹבְרִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו אֲרַ֔וְנָה וַיֵּצֵ֣א וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·raw·nāh way·yaš·qêp̄ way·yar ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ‘ā·lāw ’ă·raw·nāh way·yê·ṣê way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ap·pāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh lam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: When Araunah looked out and saw - the king - and his servants coming toward him he went out and bowed facedown . . . before the king

verses.original: מַדּ֛וּעַ אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בָּ֥א אֶל־ עַבְדּ֑וֹ אֲרַ֔וְנָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִקְנ֧וֹת הַגֹּ֗רֶן מֵעִמְּךָ֣ אֶת־ דָּוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִבְנ֤וֹת מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הָעָֽם׃ וְתֵעָצַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ bā ’el- ‘aḇ·dōw ’ă·raw·nāh way·yō·mer liq·nō·wṯ hag·gō·ren mê·‘im·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer liḇ·nō·wṯ miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al hā·‘ām wə·ṯê·‘ā·ṣar
verses.literal: Why has my lord the king come to his servant Araunah said To buy your threshing floor . . . - David replied that I may build an altar to the LORD so that the plague upon the people may be halted

verses.original: אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יִקַּ֥ח רְאֵה֙ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינוֹ וְיַ֛עַל הַבָּקָ֣ר לָעֹלָ֔ה וְהַמֹּרִגִּ֛ים הַבָּקָ֖ר וּכְלֵ֥י לָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·raw·nāh way·yō·mer ’el- dā·wiḏ ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ yiq·qaḥ rə·’êh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·ʿē·nō wə·ya·‘al hab·bā·qār lā·‘ō·lāh wə·ham·mō·rig·gîm hab·bā·qār ū·ḵə·lê lā·‘ê·ṣîm
verses.literal: Araunah said to David May my lord the king take whatever seems good to him and offer it up Here are the oxen for a burnt offering and the threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood

verses.original: הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲרַ֥וְנָה נָתַ֛ן הַכֹּ֗ל לַמֶּ֑לֶךְס אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִרְצֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ’ă·raw·nāh nā·ṯan hak·kōl lam·mɛ·lɛḵs ’ă·raw·nāh way·yō·mer ’el- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yir·ṣe·ḵā
verses.literal: O king Araunah gives all these to the king [He] also said to the king May the LORD your God accept you

verses.original: לֹ֚א וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־ אֲרַ֗וְנָה כִּֽי־ קָנ֨וֹ אֶקְנֶ֤ה מֵאֽוֹתְךָ֙ בִּמְחִ֔יר וְלֹ֧א אַעֲלֶ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י עֹל֣וֹת חִנָּ֑ם דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־ וַיִּ֨קֶן הַגֹּ֙רֶן֙ וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֔ר חֲמִשִּֽׁים׃ שְׁקָלִ֥ים בְּכֶ֖סֶף
verses.transliteration: lō way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ’ă·raw·nāh kî- qā·nōw ’eq·neh mê·’ō·wṯ·ḵā bim·ḥîr wə·lō ’a·‘ă·leh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay ‘ō·lō·wṯ ḥin·nām dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·yi·qen hag·gō·ren wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·qār ḥă·miš·šîm šə·qā·lîm bə·ḵe·sep̄
verses.literal: No replied the king - - - I insist on paying . . . - a price for I will not offer to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing So David - bought the threshing floor - and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver

verses.original: דָּוִ֤ד שָׁ֨ם וַיִּבֶן֩ מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֑ים יְהוָה֙ וַיֵּעָתֵ֤ר לָאָ֔רֶץ הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַתֵּעָצַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ šām way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh way·yê·‘ā·ṯêr lā·’ā·reṣ ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al yiś·rā·’êl wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar
verses.literal: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings Then the LORD answered the prayers on behalf of the land and the plague upon Israel was halted
